review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: We are looking for a Systems Engineer who is excited to define concepts of operations, lead requirements development and decomposition, and orchestrate integration and verification across complex UAS platforms. This role is responsible for establishing concepts of operations, leading requirements development and decomposition, defining system architectures, and driving integration and verification across multiple engineering disciplines throughout the full product lifecycle. The Systems Engineer collaborates closely with internal and external stakeholders to shape customer requirements, manage technical risk, and ensure systems meet performance, quality, and schedule objectives. Evaluate requirements decomposition to ensure completeness, consistency, and feasibility. Establish and maintain vertical and horizontal requirements traceability standards.
